finding.headline: "The Feeding-Posture Backache"
finding.problem: "After every feed my back screams and my tummy pooches more. I hunch because it's the only comfortable way. I'm stuck in a loop."
finding.person: Ngozi (2), 29, nurses baby 8×/day in a slumped position; lower-back pain + DR; can't stand straight after feeding.
finding.competition_notes: See RESEARCH BASE section of source report.

disposition.rationale: Report assigns: "Module (posture + feeding ergonomics) — cross-sells core program". Verdict: PASSES.
